aleph.title: Aleph
aleph.body: A point to see the day and the plan together.

result.title: Result
result.label: Enterprise
result.body1: The new thing you negotiate with the world and with yourself.
result.body2: Sometimes you offer an object so another will desire it. Sometimes you want to access one. In both there is a script of desire.

objective.title: Objective
objective.label: Being + Action
objective.body1: Being: how something or someone must be so another can take it — or how you must be to access.
objective.body2: Action: the steps that put that being to the test.

task.title: Task
task.label: Craft + Literature
task.body1: The step of the one who does it. It can be born loose on Home.
task.body2: Naming accompanies: what is here now, what follows, data, inventory, what stopped you.
task.body3: Failures are written to see how they differ.
